Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the SOW. Short answer: yes to both paths, with slightly different commercial and operational implications.

Two practical options we can propose quickly so you can decide which suits procurement: 

1) Timebox extension (3 weeks): we can extend the active POC window by 21 days and keep the existing SKU/pricing. Price for the 3-week extension would be a pro-rated timebox fee of $12,000 (covers reserved burst capacity and engineering priority). This keeps the same SLA and access model.

2) Convert to milestone credits: we can convert unused timebox capacity into a pool of credits tied to milestone consumption (30-day validity). Credits will be priced at a slightly higher effective rate (10% uplift) because it converts duration-based reservation into on-demand credit liquidity. We can issue $13,200 of credits (equivalent value on our uplifted pricing). Credits are redeemable against generation and embedding consumption, and we can track consumption per milestone.

If you want to keep procurement light, credits are typically faster to sign (we can do a short amendment). If you need the guarantee of reserved capacity for load-testing windows, take the timebox extension.

I’ll let Kimberly loop in pricing/legal details and David can confirm the invoice/GL flow. I’ve attached a quick pricing sketch.

Best,
Jonas

Hey all — finance note on mechanics: 

• Extension invoicing: we treat a timebox extension as a one-off invoice tied to the amendment. Payment terms: Net 30. GL code will be "POC Services" and we can supply an updated invoice that Novaflow can route to AP.

• Credit conversion: we will issue a credit memo-style amendment and create a short-term credit balance on your account. Credits will appear on the customer portal and reduce future invoices until exhausted or expired. For procurement, the amendment will reference the credit pool as a prepaid service; payment upfront is typical but we can discuss invoice milestone billing if Novaflow prefers.

• Compliance / audit: credits are tracked for accounting and audit — we can provide an itemized usage export for your finance reviewers.

One more pricing detail: if Novaflow opts for credits but needs a partial upfront invoice schedule, we can split the $13,200 into two invoices (50% up front, 50% on activation). Let me know which route you prefer and I’ll prepare the amendment text for signature.
